JUDGEMENT CALL, made deliberately: NZTA's code says hybrid; this map says mild hybrid. From February 2024 almost every row is an NZ-new Toyota Hilux or Land Cruiser 2.8L diesel with a 48V mild-hybrid system (14.9k of 15.8k in-scope rows). Mapping them as Hybrid is faithful to the code but would show ute hybrid share jumping when nothing changed for the buyer. Cost of the call: about 350 in-scope rows are full hybrids (Hino 300 and Dutro, Isuzu Elf, Peugeot diesel hybrids) and are shown as mild hybrids. See events.csv:toyota-diesel-mild-hybrid-2024.
Range-extended EV: battery drive plus a petrol generator. Classed PHEV because it carries an engine that burns fuel. About 900 rows (BMW i3 REx, Leapmotor). A documented judgement call.
Same treatment as petrol-extended. 4 rows; none in scope.
